name: Ledgerly demo
goal: Why do finance teams struggle at month-end, and what should we fix first?

themes.label: Bank matching is unreliable
themes.description: Suggested matches between bank lines and invoices are often wrong, so month-end reconciliation is mostly manual.
themes.title: Make bank matching suggestions reliable
themes.plan: Improve the matching rules and show why each match was suggested, so finance teams can trust it and stop reconciling by hand.

themes.label: Report exports time out
themes.description: Large reports and group ledgers fail or time out, forcing people to split and stitch files by hand.
themes.title: Fix large report exports
themes.plan: Run big exports in the background and email or notify when ready, with a clear error message when one fails.

themes.label: Invoice approvals are opaque
themes.description: Nobody can see who an invoice is waiting on or its approval history, and the mobile approval screen is hard to use.
themes.title: Show approval status and history
themes.plan: Add a status view with the current approver, reminders and an exportable approval history for auditors.

themes.label: Bank connection drops silently
themes.description: Bank feeds stop updating or duplicate transactions without any warning, and reconnecting is awkward.
themes.title: Alert on bank feed failures
themes.plan: Detect stalled or duplicate feeds, tell the user straight away and make reconnecting a one-step action.

themes.label: Missing accounting and payroll integrations
themes.description: Customers copy data by hand to and from payroll, ERP and accounting tools.
themes.title: Ship payroll and accounting integrations
themes.plan: Start with QuickBooks and the most requested payroll tool, with a scheduled sync instead of weekly manual uploads.

themes.label: Clean invoice templates
themes.description: Customers like how simple and professional invoices look.
themes.title: Keep investing in invoice templates
themes.plan: Protect what customers praise: add a few more template styles.

resources.title: Interview: finance lead, enterprise customer
resources.content:
Interviewer: How does month-end close go with Ledgerly today?
Participant (finance lead): Honestly it still takes us three days. We pull the bank lines into Ledgerly, but matching them to invoices is mostly manual because the suggestions are wrong about half the time. I keep a spreadsheet on the side just to track what is unmatched.
Interviewer: What happens with reports?
Participant: Every month I export the ledger report to CSV and it times out for our biggest entity. I have to split it by quarter and stitch the files together, which wastes an afternoon.
Interviewer: And approvals?
Participant: Invoice approvals are confusing. Nobody knows who the invoice is waiting on, and I have chased approvers by email more times than I can count. The one thing that works well is the invoice template, our customers say it looks very professional.

resources.title: Interview: operations manager, mid-market customer
resources.content:
Interviewer: What made you choose Ledgerly?
Participant (operations manager): The price and the clean invoice templates. Setup was quick. The problem is our bank connection drops every couple of weeks and we only notice when a payment is missing from the ledger. Reconnecting means logging in with the bank again and re-approving access.
Interviewer: Anything you wish it did?
Participant: We run payroll in another tool and our accountant uses a different package, so I wish Ledgerly had a direct integration with them. Right now I download files and upload them by hand every Friday. Also the approval screen on mobile is hard to use, I cannot see the amount and the approve button together.

resources.title: Support ticket 4821: exports and duplicate transactions
resources.content: Ticket 4821 (Free plan): Export to PDF fails with a generic error 'Something went wrong' on any report over a month. I tried three times. Also the bank feed shows the same transaction twice since Tuesday, so my balance is wrong. Please fix, I am about to file my taxes.

resources.title: Temu bual: akauntan, pelanggan enterprise
resources.content:
Penemu bual: Bagaimana proses tutup akaun hujung bulan anda?
Peserta (akauntan): Ia mengambil masa tiga hari kerana kami perlu memadankan transaksi bank dengan invois secara manual. Cadangan padanan sistem sering salah. Selain itu, laporan besar sering tamat masa apabila saya cuba eksport ke CSV. Kami juga mahukan integrasi terus dengan sistem gaji kami; sekarang kami muat naik fail secara manual setiap minggu.

resources.title: Tiket sokongan: suapan bank dan kelulusan
resources.content: Tiket (pelan Percuma): Suapan bank saya berhenti dikemas kini sejak seminggu lalu dan tiada mesej ralat. Saya juga sukar mencari butang untuk meluluskan invois. Templat invois memang cantik, pelanggan saya suka.

resources.title: Survey: what should we fix first? (Q3 free-text answers)
resources.content:
Q: What is the one thing we should fix first?
A1: Bank reconciliation. The auto-match is not reliable and I redo it by hand.
A2: Please add a QuickBooks and payroll integration, I have to copy numbers between tools.
A3: Exports fail on large date ranges.
A4: I love how simple it is to send an invoice.
A5: Approval workflow needs a status page so I can see where each invoice is stuck.

resources.title: Interview: IT administrator, enterprise customer
resources.content:
Interviewer: What blocks a wider rollout across your group?
Participant (IT administrator): Single sign-on works, but there is no integration with our payroll and ERP systems, so every entity reconciles separately. Audit is the other issue: when an invoice is approved I cannot see an approval history, and our auditors ask for it each quarter. Report exports for the group ledger fail more often than not.

resources.title: Support ticket 5130: bank sync failure before month-end
resources.content: Ticket 5130 (Growth plan): Bank sync has failed since the weekend and the reconnect button just loops back to the settings page. Month-end is tomorrow and I cannot reconcile without the latest transactions.

resources.title: Interview: freelance designer, free plan
resources.content:
Interviewer: How do you use Ledgerly?
Participant (freelance designer): I send about ten invoices a month. It is the nicest invoicing tool I have used, the templates are great. What annoys me is that when a client pays, I have to match the payment to the invoice myself because the bank feed does not link them. A QuickBooks export would also help my accountant.

resources.title: Survey: NPS comments
resources.content:
Score 9: Fast to set up and the invoices look great.
Score 4: Reconciliation is painful and support took four days to reply about my bank sync problem.
Score 6: Good value, but I need to see who has approved what, the approvals feel like a black box.
Score 5: Exporting my annual report timed out twice.
